[[File:StarkillerDeckplan-Challenge66.png|thumb|right|200px|The cargo hold of the ''Starkiller'' contained four grav-nets.]]
A '''grav-net''' was a device used to secure cargo crates in [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. There were four grav-nets in the cargo hold of the [[Frommon longhaul all-purpose transport|freighter]] ''[[Starkiller]]''.<ref name="Disturbance">{{ChallengeCite|66|Disturbance in the Force (article)}}</ref>
